test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the sentence with the correct use of subject-verb agreement:

options.text: The effects of your habits multiplies as you repeat them.
The outcomes you see in your life today is often the result of small choices made over time.
The effects of your habits multiply as you repeat them
The outcomes of your daily decisions determines your long-term success.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses how habits affect outcomes over time.
 
• The subject **"The effects of your habits"** is plural.
 
• The correct verb form to match the plural subject is **"multiply"**, not "multiplies".
 
• Thus, the sentence **"The effects of your habits multiply as you repeat them"** demonstrates correct subject-verb agreement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The effects of your habits multiplies" – Incorrect because "effects" is plural; verb must be **multiply**.
 
• **Option 2:** "The outcomes you see in your life today is" – Incorrect because "outcomes" is plural; verb should be **are**.
 
• **Option 4:** "The outcomes of your daily decisions determines" – Incorrect because "outcomes" is plural; verb should be **determine**.
